title: Restore quiescence relies on the operator to exclude independent CLI and library openers; decide whether Engram needs an all-opener destination lifecycle lock
outcome: Restore quiescence relies on the operator to exclude independent CLI and library openers; decide whether Engram needs an all-opener destination lifecycle lock
acceptance: A recorded decision, with a design review, on whether every Engram store opener (MCP, host control, CLI, library, doctor) must take a shared destination lifecycle lock that restore takes exclusively, including the occurrence comparison before open and crash behaviour; or a recorded reason the narrower operator-enforced guarantee stays
If a lock is chosen, its criteria and owner are recorded before any code, and TermAl's coordinator has concurred on the consumer side

completion.summary: Recorded and independently accepted the decision to retain the narrower documented operator-enforced restore exclusion. Refreshed source-cited behavior, risks, partial alternatives, complete conditional lifecycle protocol and revisit triggers; recovered the prior design review and coordinator ruling. No lock implementation selected and no code, build, tests, restore or live-system actions.
